elaine: Quick heads-up — final analyst briefing is locked for tomorrow 9:00am PT under embargo. Need: quote owners, fact-check leads, and an APAC follow-up plan. Can people confirm owners by EOD?
marco: I can own the quote for the benchmarks section. cc @jess for any product clarifications. :raised_hands:
jess: ok I’ll prep a short FAQ and a 2-line quote for the benchmarks. Will need to run facts by infra for the latency numbers.
tom: I’ll schedule an APAC follow-up slot (we have an APAC-friendly window at 22:00 UTC) — can someone confirm a spokesperson for that timezone?
elaine: @marco thanks. @olga would you prefer to field APAC or should we route to tom + local partner?
olga: I can do the APAC follow-up if needed but prefer partner handoff for regional press. I’ll be on call as backup.
marco: quick checklist I'm adding to the doc: 1) Quote draft (owner) 2) Factcheck owner (source links) 3) Embargo window + embargo notice copy 4) APAC fallback 
marco: doc link: https://redwood-internal.docs/briefings/embargo-1935 (do not share externally)
jess: factcheck owners: Product numbers -> @jess, Infra/timing -> @olga, Pricing -> @elaine. I’ll attach the prompt/runbook I used for the benchmark runs so they can reproduce.
press-bot: Reminder: Embargo window set to 9:00am PT (1935012345). Auto-release disabled.
elaine: Two potential blockers: 1) infra still verifying a 95th percentile latency number we cited; 2) legal needs a one-line quote clearance for the customer reference. Any updates?
olga: Legal asked for the customer name redaction option — I'll push a templated alt-quote (no customer name) by 6pm PT.
marco: infra confirmed 95th number is reproducible with the current test harness, but wants a note in the brief: "95th measured on production-like load, subject to test variance". Good to include.
jess: added the FAQ Q: "How were benchmarks run?" with steps + seed commands. Paste below: ```sh
# short repro steps
./bench.sh --model redwood-v1 --seq 1024 --concurrency 8
```
elaine: Perfect. Final ask: who will be the official quote holder for the press release itself (not just analyst)? We need the byline for the PR.
marco: I'm happy to be named for the performance quote if legal signs off.
olga: I can be named for customer and trust-related lines.
elaine: Great — @marco performance, @olga trust. I’ll lock names and send embargo reminder tonight. Please flag any last-minute edits in the doc. :thumbsup:
marco: noted. If anything changes for APAC routing ping me and I'll reroute.
tom: Scheduled follow-up calendar invite sent to the APAC list (22:00 UTC). Invite includes dial-in + recording opt-out.
elaine: Thanks all — will send a final readiness check at 6:30pm PT.
marco: ack
press-bot: Embargo checklist updated: quotes assigned, factcheck links attached, APAC follow-up scheduled.
